compatibility_specification: observable OCaml behavior for the pinned HOL Light/Flyspeck subset

entries.summary: Candle rejects OCaml float literals before elaboration

candle_observation.diagnostic: Expected to be at EOF; Parsing failed at line 1

anchor_workaround.description: replace integral float literals with float_of_int and the zero literal with Float.zero

historical_parser_support.removal_reason: runtime Double.fromString conversion was too expensive when every literal used the formatting/parsing FFI path

selected_remedy.description: restore the retained FloatT grammar path and lower each normalized decimal lexeme to Option.valOf (Double.fromString lexeme)
selected_remedy.supported_subset: decimal points, decimal exponents, and separator underscores already recognized and normalized by scan_float_or_int
selected_remedy.trust_and_performance_boundary: uses the existing double_fromString basis FFI once per literal at evaluation time; no frexp, byte-packing shim, or catch-all FFI dispatch is imported

entries.proof_obligation: CakeML grammar and conversion theories build; every accepted oracle literal produces exactly the OCaml 4.14.1 IEEE-754 word; every negative oracle is rejected; the existing Double.fromString FFI remains the explicit parsing trust boundary
entries.regression_requirement: targeted CakeML parser proof build, OCaml/Candle differential test, successful clean bertrand-primerecip load, and populated theorem plus assumption fingerprints
remaining_evidence: rebuilt Candle exact IEEE-754 differential execution
